## Summary of changes

Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced by this pull request. Explain the problem being solved or the feature being added.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Testing checklist

- [ ] Unit tests pass locally (`npm test`)
- [ ] Manual testing has been performed
- [ ] No `console.log` or debugging statements added/left behind
- [ ] Environment variables added/updated in `.env.example` and documented

## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets or sensitive information committed to source control
- [ ] SQL injection risks mitigated (using parameterized queries)
- [ ] Authentication and Authorization correctly applied to new endpoints
- [ ] Rate limiting applied to public or authentication endpoints

*(If applicable, include screenshots demonstrating UI changes or terminal output for backend features)*
